notes.title: Dwarf Land Alpha Test
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797519/e6c8bbee3299526cc2931c070fad52aac79eacc1.png[/img]


[b]ALPHA TEST Phase 1[/b]

Gates are opening, the most awaited stage of Dwarf Land's development is finally coming to your hands. It was a challenging road, but one full of adventure and triumph.

Welcome to Dwarf Land’s Closed Alpha Test Phase 1!

The time has come to delve into Dwarf Land’s rich depths! This pivotal stage of development relies on your keen insights and battle-hardened feedback. We’re eager to test gameplay, difficulty, and ensure every hidden feature and mechanic is discovered.

Your findings will help us fine-tune game progression, balance, and core mechanics. Dive in, explore, and let’s shape this adventure together. The heart of Dwarf Land awaits your wisdom!

Many more updates and events are on the horizon, so keep close to the announcements on our official media and communication channels. For more leaks and exclusive content, join us on Discord.

All relevant links can be found on Dwarf Land's store page.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797519/28b3537477e390e66ab669336fcc4781021c5760.png[/img]

notes.title: WINTER'S EMBRACE IN DWARF LAND
notes.content:
Dear Kinfolk,

As the snowflakes gracefully descend upon the meadows, we're thrilled to share that winter has arrived in Dwarf Land! The landscape is transformed into a winter wonderland, hinting at the evolving weather system.

Embrace the enchanting beauty of the season as you brave the cold,  Behold, as the familiar landscapes don a serene blanket of snow, unveiling the subtle embrace of changing seasons. Though the biting chill may set in, fear not, for this heralds the gradual unveiling of an intricate weather system.

As the frost-kissed winds weave through the towering pines, Santa's mirthful spirit stirs, leaving behind a trail of festive surprises. Stay vigilant, stalwart dwarves, for a holiday cheer awaits, a testament to the magic woven into the fabric of Dwarf Land.

While the wintry landscapes are a sight to behold, a grand adventure beckons on the horizon. As we eagerly await your footsteps in this enchanting winter realm, may your axes remain sharp, your hearts warmed by the season's joy, and your future endeavors be filled with merriment and discovery.

Cheers to the unfolding tales of our dwarven saga.
